success_predicates: Source-generation capability identity is explicit and current
Capability phase is ACTIVATED with integration evidence and activation proof
Local model/runtime proof is bound to the same execution
Execution lifetime is ONE_SHOT_OPERATION or SHORT_LIVED_WORKER
Teardown or reconstruction evidence is present
Generated files bind exact owner work/base/path/source hashes
No non-TV/TVC credential or token reaches the worker
Exact owner source packet is emitted for SHWP-FORMALISM-OWNER-MUTATION-EXECUTOR-001

Activation proof or integration evidence is missing
Persistent execution is assumed without separately admitted justification
Generated paths exceed admitted owner work
A GitHub/provider/wallet/TVC secret is consumed by the worker
Canonical AE or StegGate semantics are redefined
